answer: Sybil resistance comes from EigenTrust’s weighted trust matrix: reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so even an oasis of old praise fades without sustained honest service. A freshly spawned identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks reciprocal, trusted paths; splitting activity among copper- or bridge-named accounts does not create those paths. It cannot meet consensus thresholds until trust is earned over time.
